caveats: Administrative level 3:  37 of the 3,730 ADM3 features (in  parts of Gracias and Dios and Santa Barbara departments) have incorrect or partly incorrect parent attribute data and boundaries.   ALL existing P-codes in the layer are unique and usable but are not fully compatible with administrative level 0-2.

notes:

This dataset is structured into 2 levels:  
- Admin 1: 18   
- Admin 2: 298
